ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High disparity between central dark gray pixels and peripheral white regions; approximate 75% low-intensity to 25% high-intensity pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity white mottling along the outer margin of the left lobe; distinct white patches at the distal tips of both lobes; central and lower regions exhibit contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; prominent deep concave indentations (notches) observed on the left lobe's margin; pixel amplitude of serrations varies from 10 to 30 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, following a wide parabolic sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) at both distal tips; higher density on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-gray linear streaks visible on the dark pigmented surface of the right lobe and center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Three-dimensional calcified structures (barnacles) protruding beyond the geometric silhouette of the fluke tips, particularly on the right side.
